brief:
Build and deploy an isolated Cloud Asset Modernisation Programme showcase in GraspAI tenant5e9bd5a8-4e35-4907-ac7b-ec1dc8d1b77c as leon@graspai.co.uk, using ONLY standard Microsoft365 Business Premium end-user entitlements. Deliver a published Canvas app, SharePoint structures and two live standard-connector flows. No Dataverse app data, premium/custom connectors, AI Builder or Azure runtime dependencies. Local Agent Swarm inference is a separate infrastructure cost. Use this private demo repo and dedicated AS-E2E test resources. Preserve existing expense apps, paused Copilot, existing sites/flows/connections and global CLI profiles. Discover actual identities, licences, DLP, site/team/channel, connections and Canvas tools first; unknowns block signoff.

SharePoint Swarm Projects list: Title, BusinessArea choice Cloud Engineering/Workplace/Security/Data, EstimatedValue GBP currency, SwarmStatus choice New/Architect Synthesis/Engineering Build/QA Testing/Completed/Blocked, TechnicalSummary plain multiline. Swarm Run Logs list: Title runID, ProjectLookup to Projects.Title, AgentRole choice CEO Coordinator/Solution Architect/Fullstack Engineer/QA Lead/Delivery Gate, StepDescription plain multiline, TokensConsumed number, ExecutionDurationSeconds number, OutputStatus Success/Warning/Failure. Engineering Artifacts library: folders High Level Designs, Code & Solution Manifests, Deployment Evidence; ProjectReference text, VersionTag text, SignOffStatus Draft/Pending Review/Approved. Document minimal extra correlation/idempotency/approval fields.

Flow1 SharePoint item created/modified only when Architect Synthesis: deterministic requirements summary without paid AI, adaptive card to dedicated Agent Swarm Operations test channel, idempotent per-project artifact folder creation, status Engineering Build, correlated initial log. Prevent recursive/duplicate dispatch; retain observable failures. Flow2 evidence-file creation: validate matching project/run and genuine QA evidence, request owner Teams approval with links, status QA Testing while pending; Completed ONLY after Approved. Rejected/missing evidence never completes. Never impersonate or silently autoapprove a human. QA may test card/request and refusal paths; genuine independent signoff needs reviewer evidence.

Single responsive tablet screen: left navigation Active Swarm Pipelines/Architecture Vault/Run Telemetry; centre active Projects gallery/status chips and selected metadata/technical summary/document links; right correlated recent logs with concise action summaries (not private thoughts), actual token/duration metrics or labelled unknowns, bounded polling/refresh timestamp; Trigger New Initiative form with persisted receipt; Download Evidence Pack with real archive/link and access checks. No mocked runtime data as production proof.

Seed two labelled SYNTHETIC DEMO projects: Legacy File Share to SharePoint Migration Tool, Completed, GBP28000; Automated Tenant Security Baseline Audit, Architect Synthesis, GBP45000. Seed five linked illustrative logs spanning CEO/architect/QA with labelled synthetic metrics; two mock HLD.md and QA report files explicitly NOT acceptance evidence. Exclude synthetic seed from live dispatch/completion/signoff.

Use Agent Swarm normal discovery/design/task/review/deploy gates, relevant skills and verified MCP contracts. Commit architecture, schema, flows, Canvas source, seeds, operations/rollback/licensing docs. Acceptance requires happy/denied/missing/duplicate/retry/error paths, actual SharePoint writes/reload, live flow run/action evidence, Canvas connected sync/compile/App checker/real msapp/runtime and evidence download. Independent QA verifies exact release/target. Report blockers honestly, bounded retries and measured token use. No user questions: choose reversible scoped defaults from evidence, pause only dependent unauthenticated/unsafe work and continue other useful work.
outcome: An authorised GraspAI user can run and observe an isolated Cloud Asset Modernisation initiative in a published Canvas app using only standard-M365 SharePoint/Teams flows, with genuine QA and human completion approval.
successMeasure: The smallest real initiative is created through Canvas, persists after reload, dispatches once through Flow1 and exposes correlated real artifacts/logs and an access-checked evidence link; independent QA accepts the exact approved runner release before expansion.
scope: Complete manager brief retained; first milestone is a deployed independently accepted non-synthetic initiative/Flow1/Canvas/evidence-link slice.
Discovery and evidence-grounded design first; source/target/identity/entitlements/resources/tools and supported adapters verified before dependent work.
Full Flow2 human approval, labelled synthetic seeds and expanded polished workspace remain gated by accepted deployed first slice.
exclusions: Dataverse app data; premium/custom connectors; AI Builder; Azure runtime; activating paused Copilot.
Existing expense apps, sites, flows, connections or global CLI profile changes; resources outside the recorded dedicated AS-E2E allowlist.
Other tenants/environments or production authorisation; inferred human approval; mocked runtime acceptance; unsupported adapter substitutes.
